policies.title: Refund Policy
rules: Customers can request a refund according to applicable refund conditions.
Order status must be verified before processing a refund.
Refund eligibility must be checked against the applicable policy.
Cases requiring special approval must be escalated to human support.

policies.title: Delayed Delivery Policy
rules: The current order tracking status must be verified.
Delivery estimates must not be guaranteed without verified information.
Unresolved delivery complaints can be escalated.

policies.title: Order Cancellation Policy
rules: Order status must be checked before cancellation.
Cancellation eligibility depends on the order processing status.
Orders that cannot be cancelled automatically must be escalated.

policies.title: Damaged Product Policy
rules: Customers should provide details of the damaged product.
Replacement or refund eligibility must be verified.
